Parti Yorkie Puppy Questions

Looking for Yorkie puppies for sale in Florida? Here are the questions families ask us most about our parti Yorkie puppies in Melbourne, FL.

When are Coco's Parti Yorkie puppies ready to go home?

Coco's four parti Yorkie boys will be ready to go home December 19, 2026 — just in time for Christmas. They will have their first set of shots, be dewormed, and come with a vet health certificate, toys, a bag of food, and puppy pads.

Do you have Yorkie puppies available now?

Yes — one Parti Yorkie boy is ready now in Melbourne, Florida: the tiny toy boy (about 4 lbs full grown), $1,500 — a registered blonde parti and merle carrier. The fluffy standard boy has just been sold. Meet the boys.

Where is Best Yorkie located?

Best Yorkie (Got Your Pupz) is a family Yorkie breeder in Melbourne, Florida, in Brevard County on Florida's Space Coast, raising Yorkies since 2007. We can often meet you halfway to deliver your puppy.

What does each puppy come with?

Every puppy goes home with its Pet Pedigree Registry paperwork, a vet health certificate, age-appropriate shots, a puppy pack, and a puppy agreement and contract.
